mapper.insert: insert into trade( trade_no, product_id, buyer_id, seller_id, price, trade_type, meet_time, meet_place, status ) values ( #{tradeNo}, #{productId}, #{buyerId}, #{sellerId}, #{price}, #{tradeType}, #{meetTime}, #{meetPlace}, #{status} )
mapper.select: select t.id, t.product_id, p.title productTitle, p.main_image productImage, t.price, seller.username sellerName, buyer.username buyerName, t.status, t.create_time from trade t left join product p on t.product_id = p.id left join user seller on t.seller_id = seller.id left join user buyer on t.buyer_id = buyer.id where t.buyer_id = #{userId} order by t.create_time desc

select t.id, t.product_id, p.title productTitle, p.main_image productImage, t.price, seller.username sellerName, buyer.username buyerName, t.status, t.create_time from trade t left join product p on t.product_id = p.id left join user seller on t.seller_id = seller.id left join user buyer on t.buyer_id = buyer.id where t.seller_id = #{userId} order by t.create_time desc

select t.id, t.trade_no, t.product_id, p.title productTitle, p.main_image productImage, t.price, t.trade_type, t.meet_time, t.meet_place, t.status, t.cancel_reason, t.create_time, t.finish_time, seller.username sellerName, buyer.username buyerName, from trade t left join product p on t.product_id = p.id left join user seller on t.seller_id = seller.id left join user buyer on t.buyer_id = buyer.id where t.id = #{id}
select count(*) from trade where status = 2
select IFNULL(sum(price),0) from trade where status = 2
